about: 2.52 (Mandeep, 10 Nov 2026: 'let's do it' - Kite with Upstox and Dhan): the live price feeds. Upstox stays the main feed. Kite (Zerodha Kite Connect, market data only, never orders) runs next to it as a backup and a cross-check: the same instruments, compared every few seconds. failover: 'shadow' = Kite never feeds the app, the app only records when it would have switched and for how long (start here); 'on' = when Upstox goes quiet in market hours for failover_after_s seconds, Kite's prices feed the app until Upstox is back; 'off' = no switching. Mandeep turns it 'on' after the cross-check shows the two agree. tol_pct: how far apart the two prices may be at the same moment before it counts as a mismatch. stale_s: one feed's last trade this much older than the other's = that feed is behind. index_map: Upstox index key -> Kite exchange:tradingsymbol (others: the name in capitals). max_tokens: Kite allows 3,000 instruments per connection.
